messages.context: 作为花园访客提出委托
messages.text: I ordered a snack down to my room in the Catacombs. Took them years to find me, and even then they forgot the toppings!
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。 本次按社区 Wiki 普通呈现页补齐颜色和斜体分段；颜色仍读取服务器实时样式。
messages.zh: 我在地下墓穴的房间点了份零食。他们花了好几年才找到我,结果还把配料忘了!

messages.text: Sometimes you just have to take matters into your own hands, you know?

messages.text: I didn't expect you of all people to let me down...
